response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) as total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL') AND player_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE round = 'WS') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Total triples are summed across ALL postseason records for qualifying players, not restricted to only NL records or only WS records
The database supports NULLS LAST syntax in ORDER BY. For databases that do not (e.g., SQLite), use: ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_triples IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, total_triples DESC
